painting_requirements: No repeated horizontal retaining-wall rows; organic interconnected city blocks and winding avenues.
Keep all real estate inside the planned complete alpha/shadow footprints dry and level; never place hut, wall-face, tree or water beneath a building or its entrance apron.
Incidental houses may frame roads outside reserved plots; never bake functional buildings into backdrop.
Low theatrical three-quarter matte perspective, elevated smoky crimson horizon, dark volcanic stone and localized forge fires.
Rear public architecture modestly larger through allocation; near framing retained, no numerical scale ratio art gate.
